versions.changelog: Mentions the free evaluation API key for users without a crypto wallet
Adds broker authority check; MC lookup returns the holder; freshness caveat for FMCSA's frozen legacy data
Adds carrier selection record, roster changes, inspection and crash summary, MC lookup; pay on Solana, Base or Polygon

- Initial release of FMCSA Carrier Intelligence skill for vetting US interstate motor carriers by USDOT number.
- Provides free and pay-per-call queries about carrier authority, insurance, out-of-service status, safety history, and identity signals to help guard against double brokering and fraud.
- No account or API key required; payment for paid calls is in USDC on Solana via the x402 protocol.
- Only charges when records are returned; free tools let users preview available data before paying.
- Includes guidance on reading results and clear instructions for handling failures and payment steps.
